name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, chapter domain, descriptor reflects content (facing) + per-character indexing (char) + table data type. 'ch12' is the chapter-12 domain ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful), not a Ghidra address residue (own address is 0x52145, != ch12). Consistent with sibling facing tables in chtab2.c (ch14/ch18). Verified via disasm + reader.
purpose: Per-character sprite facing direction for the chapter 12 (Bei Shan Dao / 北山道) end scene; supplies the facing argument for the cutscene-to-battle char placement of chars 0..0xD.
logic_summary: fd2_chapter_12_end @ 0x237D5 copies all 14 bytes onto the stack via MOVSD x3 + MOVSW (no element scaling) at 0x23802/0x23807 and passes the block address as the 3rd arg (facing) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @ 0x233C6. Since the block address is >= 4, that helper reads one byte per char (bVar2 = *(byte*)(char_idx + param_3), stride 1) for char_idx 0..0xD and stores it into runtime_char.pSprite_state[1] (the sprite direction field). Sole reader; no writers.
element_semantics: One sprite facing/direction code per character (char_idx 0..0xD = 14 chars). Values are direction codes in range 1..3 (the bytes are 2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,3,1,3,1). Accessed as a flat uint8[14], one byte per char, stride 1.
notes: Memory bytes 02 02 02 02 02 02 02 02 02 02 03 01 03 01 match src exactly. Existing src comment is accurate/precise (correctly notes MOVSD x3 + MOVSW copy, chapter 12 = Bei Shan Dao, facing -> pSprite_state[1], read-only uint8[14], values 1..3); kept unchanged. Ghidra data plate at 0x52145 was empty (null), created a concise plate per src conclusion. Chapter name 北山道 confirmed via fd2-knowledge. Ghidra program saved.
